name: Salmon Quinoa Bowl
description: A protein-rich bowl with salmon, quinoa, cucumber, tomato, lemon, and olive oil.

instructions.text: Set out a saucepan with a lid, fine sieve, baking sheet, cutting board, and instant-read thermometer. Use 2 boneless salmon fillets about 5–6 ounces each. Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C).

Rinse 1 cup dry quinoa in the sieve under cold running water for 30 seconds. Put it in the saucepan with 2 cups water, or the water amount specified on its package. Bring to a boil over high heat, cover, reduce to low, and simmer for about 15 minutes until the water is absorbed. Turn off the heat and rest covered for 5 minutes. The grains should be tender with small curled sprouts.

While the quinoa cooks, line the baking sheet with parchment suitable for the oven temperature. Place the salmon skin-side down if it has skin. Rub the tops with 1 teaspoon of the 1 tablespoon olive oil. Wash hands after handling raw fish.

Bake for 12–18 minutes, depending on thickness. Insert the thermometer into the thickest center of each fillet; both must reach 145°F (63°C). If below that temperature, continue cooking and check every 2 minutes.

Wash 1 cucumber and 1 tomato. Trim the cucumber ends and cut the cucumber and tomato into bite-size pieces about 1/2 inch across. Wash 1 lemon, cut it in half, and squeeze the juice into a bowl, removing seeds.
Mix the lemon juice with the remaining 2 teaspoons olive oil. Fluff the quinoa with a fork and divide between 2 bowls. Add the chopped vegetables and drizzle over the dressing.
Place a cooked salmon fillet on each bowl, removing the skin if desired and checking for any remaining bones. Serve immediately.

source.originalInstructions: Cook quinoa. Season and cook salmon. Serve with cucumber, tomato, lemon, and olive oil.
